applicant.name: Dr. Katharina Moser
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Graz, Institute of Public Health

purpose: Our group is writing a paper on how common high blood pressure is across the federal states, as groundwork for a grant on community screening.
question: How many adults have hypertension in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Report per region: adults with hypertension.
